description: The DM's gen[] rides the response (on-demand-gen), minting an NPC behind the screen — the DM teases it into the fiction through a Morrowind-move bolded noun rather than dumping the roll.

turn.action: I ask the boardwalk vendor if she's seen anyone else pass through today.

response.narration: She squints at you over a bucket of eels, considers lying, decides against it. '**Old Merrit** came through this morning,' she says, 'moving fast for a man his age. Didn't buy anything. Didn't say why.'
response.dmNotes: gen npc minted behind the screen; surfaced via bolded proper noun, not a stat dump
